invariants.rationale: The method always constructs and returns a HoodieData instance via HoodieListData.eager.
writeStatuses is used in writeStatuses.collectAsList() and must be non-null for safe execution.
context is passed to updateLocation and used as an argument, so must be non-null for method to complete.
hoodieTable is passed to both updateLocation and HoodieListData.eager, so must be non-null for valid method execution.
